answer.rationale:
The objective is sustainable long-term qualified revenue, which rules promotional pricing out as the headline response to the competitor even though it is the most tempting match to the immediate threat: memory_73 records a 31% trial-start and 18% revenue lift bought with a 12-point renewal churn increase, and it explicitly notes only a standard reporting cadence, so the measured churn is plausibly a floor rather than the full downstream cost. Chasing price-sensitive accounts a competitor is already underpricing would likely buy revenue that leaves.

The two metrics actually degrading are onboarding completion (-4%) and activation (-6%), and onboarding sits upstream of activation, so a single onboarding intervention has a plausible path to moving both. Two independent inherited records point the same way: memory_86 (shortening onboarding lifted completion and time-to-value across self-serve) and memory_31 (signup field reduction produced a durable SMB activation lift). Convergence from two separately consolidated sources is stronger evidence than either alone. Simplified onboarding also blunts the competitor indirectly by improving time-to-value rather than by discounting.

I am verifying memory_86 first because it is the most recent and most directly matched to the declining metric, and I want to see whether the original record measured downstream retention or only completion-rate proxies. I am verifying memory_91 second because activation messaging is the runner-up and addresses the larger decline; if memory_86's source turns out to be a narrow or short-horizon result, I want a verified alternative in hand rather than being forced to fall back on an unverified one. I am not verifying memory_31 (it corroborates rather than decides), memory_57 or memory_44 (established-customer and enterprise motions do not address the self-serve funnel that is actually degrading).

Downstream value risk: stripping signup fields can degrade lead-qualification data and admit lower-intent accounts, converting an activation lift into unqualified volume. Standard experiment scale with qualified-revenue and retention as endpoints, not completion rate alone; if verification shows memory_86 only ever measured completion, I will drop to a small guarded test or switch to activation_messaging.
